style: Palette of crimson and gunmetal grey armor, polished steel, pale gold lights, dusky violet-grey sky. No text, numbers, logos or markings anywhere.

images.prompt: Wide cinematic view of a rocky battlefield at dusk with war machines of hugely different sizes. On the right, a few small boxy two-legged walker machines in the foreground; in the middle a tall humanoid war mecha robot in crimson and gunmetal armor holding a long rifle; far behind, a colossal fortress mecha the size of a mountain towers in the haze. A long armored battlecruiser hangs in the sky above. The lower left of the picture is open dark rocky ground.

High wide view of a rocky planet battlefield: a mixed army advances down from a hilltop base of factories, gantries and landing pads. Rows of small boxy walker machines and tracked tanks march in formation, led by a tall humanoid war mecha robot in crimson and gunmetal armor holding a long rifle. Dust clouds, distant enemy towers on the horizon.

A lineup of six mechanical war robots standing side by side on a flat grey plain, each one much bigger than the last, from left to right: a small crude boxy walker, a sleek armored fighting machine, a tall humanoid mecha with a rifle, a more refined humanoid mecha with glowing parts, a colossal fortress mecha, and a gigantic mecha so huge its head is lost in the clouds. Crimson and gunmetal armor, side view, size comparison.

Tall portrait scene: a boxy, clearly mechanical humanoid war mecha robot in crimson and gunmetal armor plates stands on a rocky ridge holding a long rifle, seen from a low angle. Behind it in the clouds looms the dark silhouette of a colossal mecha many times its size, its eyes glowing pale gold. The top third of the picture is a wide dusky violet-grey sky.

A rocky planet seen from orbit, its curve filling the lower part of the picture. Above it a fleet of long armored battlecruisers and carrier ships in crimson and gunmetal. From the open bay of the nearest carrier, small humanoid mecha robots launch toward the clouds below, engine glows trailing behind them. Black starry space.
